create_stv_voting: create an STVVoting instance with a specified number of winners and verbose mode
run_election_stv: run a single transferable vote election on a preference profile and return ranked outcomes
get_stv_name: get the name string of an STV voting method instance including its num_winners parameter
build_stv_preference_profile: build a preference profile with weighted votes and alternatives for STV election input
review_stv_vote_transfer: review how STV transfers votes by incrementing the active index when a candidate wins or is eliminated
